$comment: Canonical shared design space. EVERY region publication must reference this by id+version+hash. Two publications with different design_space_ref must never be intersected.
description: Reference design space for a medium fixed-wing UAV, conceptual level.

design_variables.name: t_c
design_variables.description: Streamwise thickness-to-chord ratio at the wing structural station.

design_variables.name: W0
design_variables.description: Design gross mass. Also the classic sizing fixed point: disciplines must close on it.

coupling_variables.name: W_structure
coupling_variables.description: Primary structural mass (wing box, carrythrough, fuselage frames).

coupling_variables.name: CL_max
coupling_variables.description: Maximum usable trimmed lift coefficient, flaps up.

coupling_variables.name: n_z_ult
coupling_variables.description: Ultimate load factor (3.8 limit x 1.5). Frozen by the requirement, not negotiated.

fuel_fraction.description: Mission fuel as fraction of W0, from the reference mission.

mission_ref.summary: 90 kg payload, 8 h endurance at 40 m/s, 3000 m ISA, 800 m field length.

requirements.statement: V_stall <= 28 m/s at W0, sea level, flaps up.
Cruise L/D >= 12.0 at mid-mission mass, V_cruise, sea level.
Wing tip deflection <= 10% semispan at ultimate load.
